q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_lantern_1 lantern) is emitted twice — inside the strength-0 denial at index 6 (where the indefinite "a lantern" is required to stay) and again here at top level — so the same atom is double-counted and the denied indefinite ends up asserted to exist anyway.

q2_gaps: a non-deictic season expression ("the late summer of Year 1"): Time terms cover only Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic and day-part constants, so "late summer" has no licensed form (the parse improvises the bare symbol late_summer)

a temporal adjunct naming a countable occasion ("on the first night of her apprenticeship"): the Time value slot is defined only for structured calendar terms, deictic constants and day-parts, and no during/before/after wording licenses the event-noun anchor route, so the parse puts an entity witness (sk_night_1) in the Time slot

Ordinal's scale slot for a time-period NP ("the first night of her apprenticeship"): the scale is specified as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension, neither of which this phrase supplies (the parse fills it with the class word night)
notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: negation scope with time atoms inside the strength-0 bundle, presupposed referents projected out, the Cliff Path multi-word name plus separate kind atom, leather_case / mire_essence genus-only decomposition, CoAgent for "with Pell", Start/End for sundown-to-dawn, and the definite-plural group for "the steps". Sentence 1's time frame is correctly not propagated to the later sentences.
